lines.text: Hang on a second. Let's stop the clock one more time.

Click it any time during this weave, whenever it feels right.
Okay. Sorry for the inception-style interruption. Back to the pause.

pointer.note: Kurtis's drawn character from the approved Front Row cast sheet (bucket hat, crab emblem, orange glasses on the brim), redrawn in the pose of his own photo (K tg:16471/16474).
